header_subtitle: Real stories from the communities we serve. Discover the impact of our healthcare and WASH initiatives across the globe.

featured_story.title: Bringing Clean Water to the Heart of the Valley
featured_story.summary: A new solar-powered well is transforming daily life for over 2,000 residents, reducing waterborne diseases by 80% in just three months.
featured_story.fullText: For decades, families in the valley walked over four miles every morning to collect turbid river water. In partnership with local community leaders, Ronnie Care Foundation engineered and installed a 120-meter solar submersible borehole with multi-spout distribution. Within 90 days, local clinic admissions for dysentery and typhoid dropped by 80%. Today, the system is maintained by a 6-person elected WASHCOM committee trained by our technical staff.

stories.title: Mobile Clinics Reach Remote Highlands
stories.summary: Our medical teams navigated difficult terrain to provide essential pediatric care and vaccinations to isolated communities.
stories.fullText: Equipped with 4x4 mobile outreach units and portable cold-chain vaccine storage, our clinical teams delivered critical childhood immunizations, malaria rapid diagnostics, and prenatal screenings across 7 highland hamlets previously cut off from primary healthcare infrastructure.

stories.title: Emergency Response: Flood Relief Efforts Underway
stories.summary: Following unprecedented rainfall, our disaster response teams have been deployed to distribute clean water kits and emergency medical supplies.
stories.fullText: Flash floods contaminated shallow dugouts and displaced hundreds of households. Ronnie Care mobilized within 24 hours, deploying 1,200 water purification packages, emergency oral rehydration salts, and temporary latrine sanitation stations.

stories.title: Maternal Health Clinic Milestone in Gwarinpa
stories.summary: Over 500 expectant mothers received safe delivery kits and ultrasound screenings during our quarterly clinic outreach.
stories.fullText: Safe motherhood is at the core of our primary health mandate. Through community health workers, we connected 500+ mothers to continuous antenatal care, distributed sanitized birth packs, and trained birth attendants on danger signs.

stories.title: Hygiene Champions: School Handwashing Revolution
stories.summary: Student-led hygiene committees take the lead in maintaining new school water stations and educating peers on hand hygiene.
stories.fullText: Empowering youth ambassadors creates lasting habit change. In 5 primary schools, student hygiene champions oversee handwashing stations, monitor soap restocking, and lead creative hygiene plays during morning assemblies.
